tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for Proteus mirabilis (>100,000 CFU/mL), indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and epithelial cells may suggest some urothelial irritation. Low specific gravity could reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
